title: Account dropdown menu in header with profile photo, password guidance, and delete account

requirements.summary: Make the header user identity line clickable to open an anchored, accessible account dropdown when a user profile exists.
acceptanceCriteria: When the current user is logged in and a profile exists, clicking the "name • role" line in the header opens a dropdown menu anchored to that area.
The dropdown is keyboard accessible (Enter/Space to open, Esc to close) and closes when clicking outside.
When no userProfile exists (not logged in / not set up), the dropdown trigger is not shown.

file_operations.description: Replace the static "name • role" text with an interactive trigger and wire it to a new AccountDropdown component; ensure it only renders when userProfile exists; render the user avatar/photo next to the header identity area with initials fallback. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create an account dropdown anchored to the header identity area using composed (read-only) shadcn/ui primitives (e.g., DropdownMenu) to ensure keyboard accessibility and outside-click/Esc close behavior. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create a small avatar component that displays the current user's photo when available and falls back to initials/placeholder when not. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Populate the header dropdown with required account actions plus additional useful actions, all translated via i18n and role-appropriate.
acceptanceCriteria: Dropdown includes menu items labeled exactly (in English): "Change profile photo", "Change password", "Delete account".
At least 2 additional useful account actions are included, and none of them are admin-only unless the current user is an admin.
All menu labels are translated via the existing i18n system (new keys added to translation files).

file_operations.description: Add menu items for: Change profile photo, Change password, Delete account, plus at least two additional useful actions (e.g., Edit profile, View transparency & policies, Logout). Ensure any admin-only action is conditionally rendered only when the current user is an admin. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add new translation keys for all dropdown labels and related dialog titles/descriptions/buttons; ensure the English labels match acceptance criteria exactly. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add Brazilian Portuguese translations for the new account dropdown and dialog keys added to English. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement Change profile photo flow: pick image, preview, save, and show updated photo in header with persistence and fallback to initials.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking "Change profile photo" opens a dialog with file picker and preview.
After saving, the header shows the new profile photo for the current user without requiring a full page refresh.
If the user clears/removes the photo, the header falls back to an initials/avatar placeholder.
The saved photo is persisted for the user (survives reload and new sessions).

file_operations.description: Create a dialog opened from the dropdown that supports image file selection, client-side preview, remove/clear action, and save action. Use the blob-storage component's ExternalBlob (e.g., create from bytes and display via direct URL) for photo handling and persistence. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add React Query mutations/queries needed for profile photo: a mutation to save the selected photo (using the backend capability for saving a photo) and optional query to fetch the caller's profile photo; on success, invalidate currentUserProfile and any photo-related cached data so AppHeader updates immediately. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update avatar rendering to use ExternalBlob direct URL when a photo exists (from profile or dedicated query), and fall back to initials when absent or cleared. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the "Change profile photo" menu item to open ChangeProfilePhotoDialog and pass needed handlers/state (including current photo). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure header photo display reacts to React Query updates (no full refresh) by using the profile/photo query data as the single source of truth for UserAvatar. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement Change password action as Internet Identity guidance: explain and link to Internet Identity in a new tab.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking "Change password" opens a dialog or confirm step that explains password changes are handled via Internet Identity.
The UI provides a button that opens the Internet Identity page in a new tab/window.
No attempt is made to store or change a separate app password in the canister for regular users.

file_operations.description: Create a dialog explaining that password/credentials are managed by Internet Identity and provide a button to open the Internet Identity management page in a new tab. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the "Change password" menu item to open ChangePasswordDialog. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add translation keys for Change password dialog copy and buttons (including Internet Identity link button). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add Brazilian Portuguese translation keys for the Change password dialog copy and buttons. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement Delete account confirmation dialog and UI-side flow calling existing backend delete capability, clearing cached state and returning to logged-out/onboarding state.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking "Delete account" opens a destructive confirmation dialog (cannot be triggered accidentally).

On confirmation, the frontend calls a backend method that removes the caller’s profile and all associated stored records (including links, schedules, filters, activities, locations, audit logs, and disabled flags where applicable).
After successful deletion, the UI clears relevant cached queries and returns the user to a logged-out / onboarding state.
If deletion fails, the user sees a clear error message and no partial UI state is shown as successful.

file_operations.description: Create a destructive confirmation dialog requiring explicit confirmation (e.g., typed phrase or secondary confirm step) before proceeding; on confirm, trigger the delete account mutation and show pending/success/error states. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a React Query mutation for deleting the current account (calling the backend capability) and on success clear/invalidate all profile-dependent queries and cached app data (at minimum: currentUserProfile, myChildren, myParent, schedule, contentFilter, activities, locations, auditLog, liveLocationSharing, pendingPairingRequests). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the "Delete account" menu item to open DeleteAccountDialog. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

After successful deletion, trigger Internet Identity logout via the existing auth hook and clear React Query cache so the UI returns to logged-out/onboarding state; ensure failures surface a clear error message without showing success state. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add translation keys for delete account dialog title, warning text, confirmation instructions, buttons, and error messages. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add Brazilian Portuguese translations for the delete account dialog keys. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add/extend React Query hooks for account actions (save profile photo, delete account) and invalidate dependent queries to update header and app state correctly.
acceptanceCriteria: A mutation exists for deleting the current account and invalidates/clears relevant queries (at minimum: currentUserProfile, myChildren, myParent, schedule/contentFilter/activities/locations where applicable).
A mutation exists for updating/saving the profile (including the photo) and the header updates immediately after success.

file_operations.description: Implement/extend account-focused hooks: mutation for saving profile photo and mutation for deleting caller account; ensure appropriate invalidation/clearing of dependent queries and that header-related queries update immediately after success. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Consume updated queries/hooks so the header reacts immediately to profile updates (including photo) without full refresh. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
